svg.aria-label: How a later command reaches a background task's server in the filtered and ask network modes. The command has a network of its own with nothing on localhost. A socat forwarder on the first line of the command listens on the task's port there and asks the sandbox's proxy to connect to 127.0.0.1 on that port. The proxy asks the callback in the broker, which Pi answers: yes only for a port the bridge carries or one listed in network.localhost. The proxy then dials the bridge's listener on this machine, and a python3 helper enters the task's network namespace to reach its server.
